I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from Priyanka's updates in that channel on 2025-09-03. At 14:06 she wrote that "Southgate dispatch" had totes stacked beside door 4 while label printing was stalled. At 18:43 she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. I checked that Tobias is a member of the channel before reading it.

The channel doesn't give a street address or any other site details for Southgate. The shared files have no Tansley account folder either, so I told him I couldn't find more than the depot name.
